CO_Description: The students will be able to understand and experience the entrepreneurial process through generation of creative ideas.
The students will be able to: 1) understand the market needs or provide a solution to a key problem, and 2) explore the feasibility and creation of a business enterprise.
The students will be able to implement their creative ideas into real products/services.
The students will be able to experience the dynamics of participating on a business/venture team, develop a business model, pitch to potential investors.
